intro: A look inside the Raleigh County Emergency Services Center.

photos.caption: The Raleigh County Emergency Services building in Beaver
photos.alt: A long single-story brick building with a green metal roof.

photos.caption: A telecommunicator console with four monitors
photos.alt: A dispatch console with four monitors showing call-taking, dispatch and mapping screens, with the dispatch floor behind it.

photos.caption: The dispatch floor
photos.alt: Telecommunicators working at consoles in the dispatch room.

photos.caption: The alarm monitoring station
photos.alt: A desk with three monitors, alarm monitoring equipment and a printer.

photos.caption: Street signs are made in house
photos.alt: A desk with a sign cutting machine and a green 911 Boulevard street sign above it.

photos.caption: June 2026: Drews Creek flooding
photos.alt: A washed-out and broken roadway beside a green hillside after flooding.

photos.caption: September 2026: Coal City tunnel fire
photos.alt: Smoke and flames rising from the opening of a tunnel in a wooded hillside.

photos.caption: Liberty High School bus wreck exercise
photos.alt: Fire engines and responders at a practice exercise with an overturned bus beside a football field.

photos.caption: Raleigh General mass casualty exercise
photos.alt: Responders and hospital staff in a hospital hallway with a patient on a stretcher during a practice exercise.

photos.caption: Raleigh General Hospital hazmat exercise
photos.alt: Responders in safety vests moving a patient on a stretcher past a decontamination tent at a hospital entrance.

photos.caption: Mobile command unit at a Beckley Uptown special event
photos.alt: The white Mobile Command Unit vehicle parked in front of brick buildings in uptown Beckley.

photos.caption: Inside the mobile command unit during a deployment
photos.alt: Staff working at the counters and radios inside the mobile command unit.

photos.caption: Loading disaster supplies
photos.alt: A forklift loading a pallet of bottled water onto a truck, with an Emergency Management vehicle beside it.

photos.caption: May 2026: forklift training
photos.alt: A staff member on a forklift moving a bale of shredded paper in a warehouse bay.

photos.caption: Addressing and mapping vehicle
photos.alt: A staff member seated in a white Beckley-Raleigh County Emergency Management truck.
